text: Mix Vaseline with baking soda and what happens to your skin will surprise you. The beauty industry does not want you to know this because it would cost them billions. You only need four ingredients you already have at home. Put one teaspoon of Vaseline, one teaspoon of honey, half a teaspoon of baking soda, and one teaspoon of coconut oil in a bowl. Mix for one minute until it becomes a smooth cream. Vaseline seals in moisture and creates a barrier that locks all the nutrients inside the skin. Honey is antibacterial and regenerates damaged tissue. Baking soda gently exfoliates, removes dead skin cells and fades dark spots, and coconut oil nourishes deeply and gives a natural glow that no commercial cream can match. Apply it to your face for 15 minutes, then rinse with lukewarm water. When you remove it, you will notice softer, brighter skin with a more even tone. Do this twice a week. Within a few weeks, dark spots fade, dead skin disappears, and your face recovers a glow it has not had in months. But I want you to understand something. Dark spots and dull skin do not appear just because of the sun or lack of creams. In Chinese medicine, the skin on your face is a map of what is happening inside you. Dark spots reflect an overloaded liver. Dull skin reflects a gut that is not absorbing properly, and what overloads the liver and damages the gut. The stress you carry every day. The emotions you silence. The tension you drag around without releasing. That is why there are people who spend fortunes on treatments, and their skin stays the same, because they take care of their face, but not what is damaging it from within. This mask brightens and regenerates on the outside, but if on the inside nothing changes, the spots come back. Write in the comments, New skin. If you are going to make this today, and if you want to learn how to care for your skin from where it truly begins, to cleanse what is causing the spots from the inside, and to recover a glow that comes from health and not from a cream. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that, and everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
